name: CarMD
tagline: Vehicle diagnostics and repair estimates from OBD codes
description: CarMD API provides vehicle diagnostics and repair estimates based on OBD-II trouble codes. Developers can look up diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs), get repair cost estimates, vehicle information, and maintenance data for cars.

auth.details: API key via header, self-serve signup

use_cases: decode OBD-II trouble codes for a vehicle
get repair cost estimates from diagnostic codes
